name: @fairhour/docs
description: The Fairhour documentation site (Starlight), published on GitHub Pages.

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/sync-content.ts && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && astro check && tsc --noEmit
scripts.clean: node scripts/sync-content.ts --clean && node --eval "for (const d of ['dist', '.astro', 'coverage']) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
